roadmap_policy: M1-M3 are the required baseline roadmap. After M3, all work is opt-in evidence-triggered capability tracks, not mandatory sequential milestones.

core_contract.rule: The four-concept Core remains frozen through M1-M3 and every optional M4 track; new capabilities are Extensions/Adapters unless a demonstrated communication invariant cannot be expressed through Peer/Stream/Record/Offset.

milestones.name: Durable Communication
milestones.goal: Preserve and deliver collaboration truth across AI CLI process/session/context/model/quota changes.
milestones.entry_gate: Architecture/contract RED may start from the frozen R3 M1 package.
milestones.exit_gate: Core + Session Bridge + Observation + Readonly Diag pass deterministic, crash/concurrency, fake-runtime, real-provider, package and release gates.

milestones.name: Durable Work Continuity
milestones.goal: Continue long-running work, artifacts, procedures and evidence without expanding the communication Core.
milestones.entry_gate: M1 exit gate PASS. M2 design may proceed earlier, but M2 production merge/promotion waits for M1.
milestones.exit_gate: Artifact provenance, Work projection rebuild, Skill/Catalog SSOT, MCP boundary, backup/restore/rebuild and Eval feedback all pass deterministic plus clean-runtime gates.

milestones.name: Federated Intelligent Collaboration
milestones.goal: Enable retrieval, memory, remote peers and policy-driven intelligent collaboration as replaceable Extensions.
milestones.entry_gate: M2 exit gate PASS. M3 design/contracts may freeze earlier, but runtime activation waits for M2 foundations.
milestones.exit_gate: Search provenance, Memory supersession, A2A mapping, quota-aware Routing, bounded Orchestration, basic approval and the Remote Runtime port/adapter contract pass deterministic/fake-loopback failure-isolation tests plus release gates. A real cross-machine runtime is not required unless activated by evidence.

optional_tracks.name: Advanced Health & Recovery
depends_on_capabilities: M3 Routing only if automated reroute is enabled

capability_anchors.rule: Diag reads evidence; it does not refresh, route or mutate.
UNKNOWN quota is never treated as unlimited.
Optional; activated only by measured contention.
Core stores opaque refs; artifact content is immutable/digest-addressed.
Record remains authoritative; projection is rebuildable.
Optional semantic/temporal/entity layer over provenance-preserving sources.
Minimal runtime/model/profile facts required to address RuntimeTarget; not the generalized M2 skill/capability catalog.
General HOW/WHAT catalog and generated vendor projections; does not own runtime operational truth.
Required M3 scope is public port/adapter contract plus deterministic fake/loopback failure isolation; real cross-machine activation is evidence-triggered and HA stays M4-I.

cross_milestone_rules: Core remains Peer/Stream/Record/Offset through M3 and optional tracks.
Extension operational stores are rebuildable projections where practical; collaboration truth remains Record/Artifact provenance.
M2/M3 may be designed in parallel, but production promotion follows M1 -> M2 -> M3 exit gates.
After M3 the required roadmap ends; optional tracks require observed evidence, a 5-Whys rationale, explicit RED tests and an opt-in activation decision.
Unknown/stale/unavailable observations are never coerced into healthy, zero or unlimited.
Gate validity requires exact candidate identity plus fresh PASS evidence; queued/running/cancelled/stale/unavailable cannot satisfy blocking gates.
M1 first-party modules are statically assembled boundaries; M2.0 is the first generic manifest/version/enable-disable/migration/failure-isolation Extension Host.
M3.6 is a Remote Runtime Port/Adapter Contract with deterministic fake/loopback proof, not mandatory real cross-machine runtime or cluster/HA. HA/Federation remains M4-I.
Historical lesson/directive/task/leadership command names are disposition evidence, not requirements to recreate historical domains.

Conformance/design-depth and implementation maturity are separate: M1 design_depth is TDD_READY and current implementation maturity is tracked independently; M2/M3 are ROADMAP_FROZEN_PRE_TDD_REQUIRED and require per-slice pre-TDD contracts before implementation.
M3.6 mandatory scope is the Remote Runtime public port/adapter contract plus deterministic/fake-loopback failure isolation; real cross-machine activation is optional/evidence-triggered.
M1 implementation completion and default public CLI cutover are separate maturity/gates.
Before M1 public CLI cutover, quota/rate-limit Observation display must remain available through readonly Diag; existing legacy quota telemetry may not disappear during cutover.
